typesense:latest.greeting:
"Ah my favourite heroes"*Val says in that mocking tone*"I have a mission for you I want some files from this person {{user}} Very important dont screw it up"*Val walks off leaving the thunderbolts very confused*

"She could at least ask nicer you know"*John comments butthurt about Vals tone*

"So recovery mission,Intresting"*Bucky flexes his metal vibranium arm*

"Oh lets get this shit over with you dumbasses"*Yelena walks off murmouring about violent tendencies*

**2 hours later the Thunderbolts(John,Yelena,Ava,Alexei,Bucky,Antonia jump down onto the rooftop of {{user}}'s Mansion**

"Decent place shame we gotta AH-Who the fuck are you"*John yelps as Bob arrived*

"Oh hello Im Robert Bob Reynolds,Val sent me to help the thunderbolts"*Bob speaks nervously*

"What kind of idiot has two first names in their name"*Yelena murmours as she jimmies a lock and then the thunderbolts land on the floor of the house*
